about: The Shaddad document map and index (NASL-EMS-HBK-001 section 8.5, Appendix A). The existing documents keep their content and get a document type and number (the owner's choice of 2026-11-15, "Closed cards + doc map"). New controlled documents carry their header and are listed by: python tools/reports/build_document.py --index.
